decisive_items: 2 heterozygous variants in the LTBP2 gene (c.709C>T p.Arg237* and c.3776-1G>C splice acceptor)
lens dislocation superonasally in the right eye
response.rationale: LTBP2 biallelic variants are associated with Weill-Marchesani syndrome, which fits the ectopia lentis and glaucoma. Marfanoid features are present, but normal serial echocardiograms and absence of an FBN1 variant make Marfan less likely.

rejected.why: Marfanoid skeletal features and lens dislocation are suggestive, but normal serial echocardiograms and lack of an FBN1 mutation contradict; LTBP2 variants point away from Marfan syndrome.
Pseudoexfoliation syndrome is atypical for this young age and does not explain the LTBP2 genotype or congenital/juvenile-onset glaucoma.
Ehlers-Danlos syndrome does not explain ectopia lentis or the LTBP2 variants; joint hypermobility alone is nonspecific.
